statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient was evaluated with diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
